lines.zh: 我的脚掌贴着岩浆边走。
lines.en: My feet hug the edge of the lava flow.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖过黑石，留下热痕。
lines.en: My tail drags over blackstone, leaving a hot streak.

lines.zh: 我在火山灰上走得很轻。
lines.en: I walk lightly across the volcanic ash.

lines.zh: 鳞片贴着热浪起伏。
lines.en: My scales ripple with the rising heat.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在未凉的石上。
lines.en: Every step lands on stone that has not cooled.

lines.zh: 我顺着岩浆海岸巡自己的地盘。
lines.en: I patrol my ground along the lava shore.

lines.zh: 走路时喉咙里冒着白气。
lines.en: White vapor leaks from my throat as I walk.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁走，省力。
lines.en: I keep to the rock wall to save effort.

lines.zh: 脚爪抓地，灰烬四散。
lines.en: Claws take hold and ash scatters.

lines.zh: 下界荒地上，脚印会烧。
lines.en: In the Nether wastes, my footprints burn.

lines.zh: 我小跑起来，像一串火星。
lines.en: I break into a trot, a string of sparks.

lines.zh: 绯红森林的根被我踩焦。
lines.en: I scorch the roots of the crimson forest.

lines.zh: 我绕过岩浆池，从不掉进去。
lines.en: I go around lava pools and never fall in.

lines.zh: 走路对我来说，是巡猎。
lines.en: Walking, for me, is patrol hunting.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，灰烬还在冒烟。
lines.en: Where I walk, the ash keeps smoking.

lines.zh: 岩浆的亮光在我背上滚。
lines.en: Lava light rolls along my back.

lines.zh: 我趴在热石上，把肚子烘干。
lines.en: I lie on hot stone and dry my belly.

lines.zh: 岩浆就在旁边，我看着它冒泡。
lines.en: Lava is right beside me; I watch it bubble.

lines.zh: 鳞片缝里冒着细细的烟。
lines.en: Thin smoke rises from the gaps in my scales.

lines.zh: 舌头一卷，我尝到硫磺的味道。
lines.en: One flick of my tongue and I taste sulfur.

lines.zh: 这地方很热，正好适合我。
lines.en: This place is hot, which suits me exactly.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴盘成半圈。
lines.en: I curl my tail into a half circle.

lines.zh: 火山灰落在我背上，一层。
lines.en: Ash settles on my back, a whole layer.

lines.zh: 我在等下界荒地起风。
lines.en: I wait for the Nether wastes to stir.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的火苗轻轻地跳。
lines.en: The small flame in my throat dances gently.

lines.zh: 二十颗心的身体，静得像石头。
lines.en: A twenty heart body, still as stone.

lines.zh: 我听见远处岩浆的流动声。
lines.en: I hear lava moving in the distance.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛半闭，耳朵醒着。
lines.en: My eyes are half shut, my ears awake.

lines.zh: 这片热土养了我很久。
lines.en: This hot ground has fed me a long time.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像块滚烫的岩。
lines.en: I stay still, like a scorching rock.

lines.zh: 你站得太靠岩浆了。
lines.en: You are standing too close to the lava.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，舌头先伸出来。
lines.en: I raise my head, tongue first.

lines.zh: 你的靴底已经开始焦了。
lines.en: The soles of your boots are already charring.

lines.zh: 我的鼻孔喷出两缕白烟。
lines.en: Two threads of white smoke leave my nostrils.

lines.zh: 下界里很少有活的影子。
lines.en: There are few living shadows in the Nether.

lines.zh: 我歪头，鳞片擦出轻响。
lines.en: I tilt my head and my scales click softly.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道很凉。
lines.en: The smell of you is very cold.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，只是想看看。
lines.en: I come closer slowly, only to look.

lines.zh: 你的脚跟已经朝后挪了半寸。
lines.en: Your heel has already shifted back half an inch.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴尖点了点地面。
lines.en: I tap the ground with the tip of my tail.

lines.zh: 我的鳞裂了，里面还是烫的。
lines.en: My scale split, and it is still hot inside.

lines.zh: 这一下，你烫到手了吧。
lines.en: That must have burned your hand.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音像开水。
lines.en: I cry out, and it sounds like boiling water.

lines.zh: 我退开半格，不是怕。
lines.en: I back off half a block, and not from fear.

lines.zh: 我的血滴在黑石上，滋滋作响。
lines.en: My blood drips on blackstone and hisses.

lines.zh: 疼，但这点热度伤不到我。
lines.en: It hurts, but this heat cannot harm me.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾巴，抖掉灰。
lines.en: I whip my tail and shake off the ash.

lines.zh: 你打得不错，我会记住。
lines.en: You struck well, and I will remember.

lines.zh: 我低头舔了舔伤口。
lines.en: I lower my head and lick the wound.

lines.zh: 这点力道，还差得远。
lines.en: That force is nowhere near enough.

lines.zh: 岩浆才是我最想吃的东西。
lines.en: Lava is what I most want to eat.

lines.zh: 你手里的肉，烤一烤再说。
lines.en: Roast that meat in your hand first.

lines.zh: 我对热的东西没抵抗力。
lines.en: I have no resistance to hot things.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，我先看你的手。
lines.en: You hold out food; I look at your hand first.

lines.zh: 火山蜥的胃口小，但很挑。
lines.en: A volcano lizard has a small but picky appetite.

lines.zh: 那块肉闻着不错，放下吧。
lines.en: That meat smells decent; put it down.

lines.zh: 我靠近了半步，又停住。
lines.en: I come half a step closer, then stop.

lines.zh: 你要是敢喂我，我可记住了。
lines.en: If you dare feed me, I will remember it.

lines.zh: 热食才配得上我这副牙齿。
lines.en: Only hot food deserves these teeth.

lines.zh: 我不贪心，一口就够。
lines.en: I am not greedy; one bite is enough.

lines.zh: 我的鳞很烫，别贴太久。
lines.en: My scales are hot; do not lean too long.

lines.zh: 撞我，你会先闻到焦味。
lines.en: Bump me and you will smell burning first.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，尾巴扫到你腿。
lines.en: I shift and my tail sweeps your leg.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞，我不当回事。
lines.en: A small collision like that means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我蹭过去，像蹭一块热石。
lines.en: I rub past you like a hot stone.

lines.zh: 你的护甲被我擦出一道印。
lines.en: Your armor takes a scorch mark from me.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从你脚边挤过。
lines.en: I crouch low and squeeze past your feet.

lines.zh: 再踩一次，我的尾巴会抽回来。
lines.en: Step on it again and my tail comes around.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，灰扬了起来。
lines.en: We collide and the ash rises around us.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，算是让了。
lines.en: I back off half a step, which counts as yielding.

lines.zh: 我把蛋埋进最热的火山灰里。
lines.en: I bury my eggs in the hottest ash.

lines.zh: 求偶时，我会绕着对方转圈。
lines.en: When courting, I circle the other one.

lines.zh: 这条海岸线，只有我一个。
lines.en: On this shoreline, I am the only one.

lines.zh: 我对着岩浆吐了口气。
lines.en: I breathe out at the lava.

lines.zh: 伴侣要能忍得住这热度。
lines.en: A mate would have to endure this heat.

lines.zh: 我不筑巢，热土就是巢。
lines.en: I build no nest; the hot earth is the nest.

lines.zh: 我们的亲近，是并排贴石。
lines.en: Our closeness is lying side by side on stone.

lines.zh: 我贴着石面，把热气分它一半。
lines.en: I press against the stone and share half my heat.

lines.zh: 这一窝蛋，会自己烧出来。
lines.en: This clutch will burn its own way out.

lines.zh: 你们这些活人，问得太细了。
lines.en: You living folk ask far too many details.

lines.zh: 地上那块火炭，我叼起来。
lines.en: I pick up that burning coal from the ground.

lines.zh: 岩浆结的壳，我咬得动。
lines.en: The crust that lava leaves is soft to my teeth.

lines.zh: 我只捡能烧的东西。
lines.en: I only pick up things that can burn.

lines.zh: 那枚金币太凉，我不碰。
lines.en: That gold coin is too cold; I leave it.

lines.zh: 我低头，闻了闻就放下。
lines.en: I lower my head, sniff, and drop it.

lines.zh: 爪子夹东西，不太方便。
lines.en: Claws are awkward for holding things.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，多半不好吃。
lines.en: Most things dropped on the ground are not worth eating.

lines.zh: 我把热石头拨到一边。
lines.en: I nudge the hot stones aside.

lines.zh: 我没兴趣收你们的宝贝。
lines.en: I have no interest in collecting your treasures.

lines.zh: 捡东西留给会弯腰的。
lines.en: Picking things up is for those who can bend.

lines.zh: 你身上有一点热，我闻到了。
lines.en: There is a little heat on you, and I smell it.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，四脚先绷紧。
lines.en: I raise my head and my four legs go taut.

lines.zh: 目标出现，喉咙里的火亮了。
lines.en: A target appears and the fire in my throat brightens.

lines.zh: 这下界荒地，只够一个人走。
lines.en: These Nether wastes are only wide enough for one.

lines.zh: 我盯住了你，尾巴停止摆动。
lines.en: I fix on you and my tail stops swaying.

lines.zh: 你走进我的热圈了。
lines.en: You have walked into my circle of heat.

lines.zh: 我压低前身，准备冲。
lines.en: I lower my front and prepare to lunge.

lines.zh: 活的东西，总比石头有趣。
lines.en: Living things are always more interesting than stone.

lines.zh: 我先叫了一声，算是提醒。
lines.en: I call out once, as a warning.

lines.zh: 现在我决定追你。
lines.en: Now I have decided to chase you.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面跑，比你稳。
lines.en: I run low to the ground, steadier than you.

lines.zh: 你别往岩浆边退。
lines.en: Do not back toward the lava.

lines.zh: 我在灰里留了你的方向。
lines.en: I have kept your direction in the ash.

lines.zh: 我一边跑，一边吐火星。
lines.en: I run and spit sparks as I go.

lines.zh: 这条路上，你跑不过我。
lines.en: On this ground, you cannot outrun me.

lines.zh: 我转弯比你快半拍。
lines.en: I turn half a beat faster than you.

lines.zh: 我会一直跟着，直到你停下。
lines.en: I will keep following until you stop.

lines.zh: 你越靠近红石，我越兴奋。
lines.en: The closer you get to red stone, the more excited I am.

lines.zh: 我的爪子记住了你的味道。
lines.en: My claws remember your scent.

lines.zh: 你回头只会看见一串火星。
lines.en: Turn around and you will only see sparks.

lines.zh: 七点，一口咬在腿上。
lines.en: Seven points, one bite into your leg.

lines.zh: 牙关锁紧，你的腿在我嘴里发烫。
lines.en: My jaws lock; your leg burns inside my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的牙不深，但很烫。
lines.en: My teeth are not deep, but they are hot.

lines.zh: 这一口，带起一股焦味。
lines.en: That bite leaves a smell of scorching.

lines.zh: 我再用尾巴抽你一下。
lines.en: Then I lash you once with my tail.

lines.zh: 你护甲烫得发亮。
lines.en: Your armor is glowing hot.

lines.zh: 我吐出火星，趁你闭眼。
lines.en: I spit sparks while your eyes are shut.

lines.zh: 这就是火山蜥的打法。
lines.en: This is how a volcano lizard fights.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我的爪子就更近。
lines.en: Every step you retreat brings my claws closer.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔嘴，准备再来。
lines.en: I lick my mouth and get ready again.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆边上爬出来，浑身是烟。
lines.en: I crawl out by the lava, covered in smoke.

lines.zh: 灰里亮起两点橙色的光。
lines.en: Two orange lights come up in the ash.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖鳞，火星掉了一地。
lines.en: I shake my scales and sparks fall everywhere.

lines.zh: 火山灰自己塌了一块，我就在那儿。
lines.en: A patch of ash collapses; there I am.

lines.zh: 这一片热土，又归我了。
lines.en: This hot ground is mine again.

lines.zh: 我出来时，空气好像更烫了。
lines.en: When I emerge, the air seems hotter.

lines.zh: 下界荒地多了一道影子。
lines.en: The Nether wastes gain one more shadow.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里探出头，看了看。
lines.en: I poke my head from a crack and look around.

lines.zh: 绯红森林的味道，我认得。
lines.en: I know the smell of the crimson forest.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气，带出一串火。
lines.en: My first breath comes out as a string of fire.

lines.zh: 火烧我，跟洗澡差不多。
lines.en: Fire on me is about the same as a bath.

lines.zh: 从岩上滑下来，摔得有点晕。
lines.en: I slid off the rock and landed dizzy.

lines.zh: 水？下界只有更热的东西。
lines.en: Water? The Nether only has hotter things.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻了我，我翻身就起。
lines.en: The blast flipped me, and I rolled upright.

lines.zh: 箭扎进鳞缝，很别扭。
lines.en: An arrow wedged in a scale gap; it is awkward.

lines.zh: 魔法把热从我身上抽走一点。
lines.en: Magic pulls some of the heat out of me.

lines.zh: 我饿得很快，这身体烧得凶。
lines.en: I get hungry fast; this body burns hard.

lines.zh: 我讨厌雷，它比我还亮。
lines.en: I hate lightning; it is brighter than I am.

lines.zh: 虚空很冷，我不喜欢。
lines.en: The void is cold, and I do not like it.
